notes.title: Whirlight: No Time to Trip – New Demo Update!
notes.content:
Hey adventurers!

We’ve been hard at work, and thanks to your incredible feedback, we’re excited to bring you a freshly updated demo for Whirlight: No Time to Trip! 🎉 That’s right—Hector’s adventures just got a whole lot smoother, and we’ve thrown in some awesome new features, plus a brand-new location for you to explore!

🚀 Here’s what’s new:

[list]
[*] 🏃 Run on double-click—because sometimes even a time-traveling genius is in a hurry!
[*] 📜 Mark conversations you’ve already read—no more accidental deja vu.
[*] 🎨 Fresh new cursors for that extra bit of style.
[*] 💾 Updated saving/loading UI—so sleek, Hector might even approve!
[*] 🐞 And of course, we’ve squashed some pesky bugs.
[/list]

[b]⚠️ Heads-up: The new run feature works only with a new game, not with saves from the previous demo version. So, why not give it a fresh start and enjoy the latest tweaks?[/b]

But wait, there’s more! 🌟 We're working on a brand-new location and here's a little sneak peek!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868276/37b05948b7a03f57e66bb9a871bb984f6e834f1d.jpg[/img]

🎮 Haven’t played the demo yet? No worries! Jump in now: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2706980/Whirlight__No_Time_To_Trip/]Play the Demo[/url]

🛎️ Don't forget to wishlist Whirlight: No Time to Trip on Steam! It helps us immensely, and you won’t miss any future updates or surprises we have in store.

We love hearing from you!

Thank you for your support, and we can’t wait to hear what you think of the new demo!

notes.title: Whirlight - No Time To Trip Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
Hey adventurers!

[h2][b]Whirlight - No Time to Trip's Demo is now live![/b] [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868276/93f18d8f5439d97203ec80f5b2dd0c009b017277.jpg[/img]

Step into the shoes of Hector, our quirky middle-aged scientist whose luck is as peculiar as his inventions. Alongside Margaret, a strong and determined artist, you'll explore the charming Verice Bay, journey through time, and meet an array of bizarre characters.

Whirlight - No Time to Trip is a [b]point-and-click adventure[/b] that captures the spirit of classic games like "Day of the Tentacle" and "Sam & Max Hit the Road," with its whimsical humor, hand-drawn graphics, and engaging story. From the acclaimed developers of "[b]Willy Morgan and the Curse of Bone Town[/b]," this game promises a unique and unforgettable experience.

What's in the demo?

[list]
[*] [b]Dive into the early chapters[/b] of Hector and Margaret's adventure.
[*] Experience the vibrant, cartoony atmosphere and witty dialogue.
[*] Get a taste of the time-traveling mechanics and puzzle-solving fun.
[/list]

🚀 Play the demo now and join Hector's extraordinary journey!

🌟 We're also excited to announce our participation in the [b]Adventure Game Fan Fair on July 26-28.[/b] While we won't be attending in person, we'll be connecting with players on-site, sharing insights, and answering your burning questions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868276/564eba86c882f766fc2fe5351c5b861cafc3a289.jpg[/img]


🔔 Don't forget to [b]wishlist Whirlight: No Time to Trip[/b] to stay updated on the latest news and developments. Your support helps us bring this adventure to life!

🎉 Join our community! Be part of the conversation and share your experiences with fellow adventurers on our Discord server [[url=https://discord.gg/vyxA5Mmm52]Join Here[/url]]. Your feedback is invaluable to us!

Thank you for being a part of this whimsical journey. We can't wait to hear about your adventures in Verice Bay!

If you like our demo, please consider supporting us with a wishlist! Happy adventuring!

[url=https://discord.gg/vyxA5Mmm52]Join our Discord server[/url] and be part of the community!
